narrative: (Policyholder with Suncorp home and contents insurance, including accidental damage cover.) On 2 August 2026 the hot water tank in our garage burst at the base overnight. The water ran out under the garage door onto the driveway so nothing else was damaged, but the tank itself is finished. A plumber quoted $2,400 to remove it and install a replacement tank. Policy number SUN-5520913.

(Policyholder with GIO home and contents insurance, including accidental damage cover.) On 19 July 2026 the boiler in our benchtop espresso machine exploded while it was heating up. Nobody was hurt and the kitchen is fine apart from a bit of water on the bench, but the machine is a write-off. It cost $1,800 and I'd like it replaced.

(Policyholder with BudgetDirect home and contents insurance. I didn't take the accidental damage option.) On 6 January 2026 a bushfire burned through bushland about 2 kilometres from our house. The fire never reached our street, but smoke and ash came in through the vents for two days and the curtains, couch and ceilings are stained and smell. Cleaning and replacing the curtains is quoted at $3,100.

(Policyholder with ING contents insurance. I own an apartment in a strata building.) On 11 September 2026 a storm knocked out power in our building and when it came back the electric hot water system inside my apartment had failed and the air conditioning unit wouldn't start. An electrician says both need replacing, around $4,200 in total. I haven't checked with the body corporate yet.

(Policyholder with CGU home insurance.) On 22 June 2026 strong winds during a storm blew over about 15 metres of our timber side fence. A fencing contractor quoted $3,200 to replace it. Policy number CGU-HB-771204.

(Policyholder with CommBank home insurance.) On 14 March 2026 a hailstorm cracked a lot of the roof tiles on our house and rain got into the ceiling of the main bedroom. A roofer quoted $4,800 for the tiles and the ceiling repair.

(Policyholder with Westpac home and contents insurance.) On 3 May 2026 someone broke in through the back sliding door while we were at work and took a laptop and some jewellery. Police attended and gave us an event number. The laptop was $1,900 and the jewellery about $1,600.

(Policyholder with Shannons home contents insurance.) On 28 August 2026 my son knocked our 65-inch TV off the entertainment unit while playing and the screen cracked. It cost $1,600 two years ago. I'm not sure whether our policy includes accidental damage.

(Policyholder with RACWA building and contents insurance.) We took out our policy on 1 February 2026 because we'd never had home insurance before. The next day, 2 February 2026, heavy rain caused the river to flood and water came through the ground floor. Carpets, a lounge suite and the lower plasterboard are damaged, estimated at $14,000.

(Policyholder with RACWA landlord insurance.) Our tenant moved out on 30 June 2026 and left holes punched in several walls and a broken internal door. The property manager thinks it was done deliberately. The repair quote is $2,700. Policy number RAC-LL-30918.
